decisions.reason: The one-scale-variation allowance for the mustard pareo is already represented by its same-message MODIFY; the terracotta color change does not alter the mustard pareo.
The source confirms the block-pareo brief but does not change the existing Pantone, CMYK, visual-approximation, or ICC-profile workflow.
The basket-weave scale reference is acknowledged only as supplied context; no basket-weave design attribute or scope is changed.
The source decision concerns the block-color pareos and does not change the zebra print's palette, stripe treatment, border, or scope.
Adding and specifying the block-color pareos does not change the existing requirement to deliver production-ready artwork files.
